announcements.headline: New Valens Pay Platform and BaaS Offering
announcements.insight: VP Fintech Group launches a new platform following its August acquisition of GlblNexus Inc., signaling integration of acquired assets into its infrastructure offerings.

announcements.headline: VP Fintech Group Completes Acquisition of GlblNexus Inc.
announcements.insight: The acquisition of GlblNexus Inc. completes the process proposed in June, following the independent valuation report published in August.

announcements.headline: Publication of the Independent Willis Capital Valuation Report
announcements.insight: VP Fintech Group Ltd publishes an independent valuation report. This follows the proposed acquisition of GlblNexus Inc in June and the VIP platform introduction in July.

announcements.headline: Introduction of the VP Infrastructure Platform (VIP)
announcements.insight: VP Fintech Group Ltd introduces the VP Infrastructure Platform (VIP), following its proposed acquisition of GlblNexus Inc. and Valens Pay joining the Circle Alliance Program.

announcements.headline: Valens Pay Joins Circle Alliance Program to Advance Global Stablecoin Payment Infrastructure
announcements.insight: VP Fintech Group Ltd announces a partnership. This follows the June 2026 proposed acquisition of GlblNexus Inc., suggesting integration or expansion related to that deal.

announcements.headline: Proposed Acquisition of GlblNexus Inc.
announcements.insight: VP Fintech Group Ltd proposes acquiring GlblNexus Inc. This initial filing marks the start of a potential material acquisition process for shareholders to monitor.
